Oocyte and embryo maturation failure causes female infertility; purely reproductive disease outside the axes.
Inherited sideroblastic anemia with ring sideroblasts and additional cytopenias; disease of marrow and blood cells.
Inflammation of ileal pouch mucosa. Associated C. difficile colitis is a separate infection; inflammation alone does not establish an immune mechanism.
Defined by isolated growth hormone deficiency and congenital hypogammaglobulinemia; endocrine dysfunction and antibody immunodeficiency.
Congenital shortening or absence of middle phalanges, sometimes with joint fusion; skeletal malformation.
IgE-mediated or T-cell-mediated hypersensitivity to latex products; transient allergic manifestations do not establish lasting organ damage.
Genetic neurodevelopmental disorder defined by developmental impairment and epileptic encephalopathy; extra-neural findings vary by subtype.
Hereditary fibrous overgrowth of gingiva; gums belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Pure anxiety/phobic disorder without defined damage to an organ axis.
Spastic paraplegia, neuropathy and cognitive impairment; ancestors identify a phospholipid metabolic disorder. Additional endocrine deficits lack established frequency.

Defined by chronic hypertension with resultant renal vascular and glomerular damage.
Cribriform ductal carcinoma in situ confined to the breast; breast has no axis.
Keratinizing lesion originates in maxillary sinus mucosa; sinuses are pulmonary. Possible bone erosion and secondary infection lack qualifying frequency.
Congestive splenic enlargement with blood-cell destruction and portal hypertension characterizes Banti syndrome. Underlying cirrhosis is a separate disease.
Primary menstrual pain without underlying pelvic pathology; reproductive condition outside the axes.
Photosensitive skin disease with scarring; developmental delay, microcephaly and intellectual disability reported in 1/1. Photophobia alone does not establish ocular damage.
Disease of the optic chiasm, a central nervous system structure; visual consequences do not establish separate eye damage.
Skeletal dysplasia with camptodactyly and scoliosis; mild intellectual disability described in the sole reported family of three affected siblings.
Hypophosphatasia metabolic defect defined here by premature tooth loss or severe caries; skeletal abnormalities explicitly absent.
Autoimmune inflammatory myopathy with characteristic skin lesions; interstitial lung disease and pulmonary fibrosis occur in roughly 30% or more.
Defined by pregnancy-associated tonic-clonic seizures and hypertension; neurologic and vascular involvement qualify despite obstetric context.
